property_summary: Rule: only the admin (the deployer) can successfully call setOwner and change owner; the mutant inverts the check allowing non-admins to change owner, so there exist callers for which owner differs after setOwner between reference and mutant.
change_summary: Inverted the authorization check in onlyAdmin so only non-admins may call setOwner, changing who can change owner and thus observed owner after calls.
